item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 21, 2026
item.description: When we can't find stable ground, we must build it ourselves. Our actions today could reopen old scars, but if they do, those wounds probably need to air out once more to truly heal. This will be especially poignant around the Moon's merge with thoughtful Chiron this morning. We're ready to choose empathy. Luna then settles into Taurus at 6:30 pm EST, inviting us to take our time building the life we want. Success comes from a lifetime of responsible routines and healthy choices.

item.title: Fake immigration lawyers staged sham court hearings to scam migrants: feds
item.description: Con artists posing as immigration lawyers created fake legal documents and even staged sham court proceedings to dupe migrants seeking legal pathways to U.S. residency out of their hard-earned money, prosecutors said.

item.title: Texas man was fatally shot by a federal immigration agent last year during a stop, new records show
item.description: The death of 23-year-old Ruben Ray Martinez occurred in March on South Padre Island.

item.title: Woman, 88, attacked by homeless man who steals her cane outside Union Square Target
item.description: The victim was about to enter the big-box retailer on Union Square East at E. 14th St. when a man sitting on the pavement outside stood up and grabbed her arm around 3:15 p.m. Thursday, police said.

item.title: Long Island child therapist gets 7 years for sharing videos of babies being raped
item.description: Renee "Rina" Hoberman, a child therapist in Melville, pleaded guilty last June to distributing videos featuring men raping screaming babies.

item.title: Scientists change how El Niño is labeled to keep up with spike in temperature
item.description: El Niños tend to increase global temperatures and La Niñas depress the long-term rise.

item.title: Dad accused of beating own son, 2, to death in Queens shelter charged with murder
item.description: Dayvon Morrison, 30, was charged with two counts of murder and acting in a manner injurious to a child for the savage assault that left his son, Maliek, 2, with severe brain damage and numerous other injuries on Jan. 30.

item.title: Woman found dead in Harlem apartment with head trauma
item.description: Responding officers found the unidentified woman's lifeless body inside an apartment at a mixed-use building on W. 124th St. near Adam Clayton Powell Jr. Blvd. around 1:38 p.m., police said.

item.title: Nets’ comeback bid stalls in 105-86 road loss to Thunder
item.description: Despite a sharper start and a spirited third-quarter push, Brooklyn fell to the Oklahoma City Thunder 105-86 at Paycom Center.
